title: The Weight of a Glass of Water
simplified_paragraphs: 有一位老师正在给学生们上课，大家都认真地听着。"大家认为这杯水有多重？”说着，老师拿起一杯水。有人说200克，也有人说300克。"
是的，它只有200克。那么这杯水你们可以拿多久呢？”老师接着说，"拿1分钟，各位一定觉得没问题；拿1个小时，可能觉得手酸；拿1天呢？1个星期呢？那可能得叫救护车了。”大家都笑了。
老师继续说："其实这杯水的重量很轻，但是你拿得越久，就觉得越沉重。这如同把压力放在身上，不管压力是否很重，时间长了就会觉得越来越沉重而无法承担。所以，我们所承担的压力，应该在适当的时候放下，然后再重新拿起来，如此才能坚持更久。”
traditional_paragraphs: 有一位老師正在給學生們上課，大家都認真地聽著。"大家認為這杯水有多重？”說著，老師拿起一杯水。有人說200克，也有人說300克。"
是的，它只有200克。那麼這杯水你們可以拿多久呢？”老師接著說，"拿1分鐘，各位一定覺得沒問題；拿1個小時，可能覺得手酸；拿1天呢？1個星期呢？那可能得叫救護車了。”大家都笑了。
老師繼續說："其實這杯水的重量很輕，但是你拿得越久，就覺得越沉重。這如同把壓力放在身上，不管壓力是否很重，時間長了就會覺得越來越沉重而無法承擔。所以，我們所承擔的壓力，應該在適當的時候放下，然後再重新拿起來，如此才能堅持更久。”

english_paragraphs: A teacher was giving a lesson, and the students were listening attentively. “How much do you think this glass of water weighs?” the teacher asked, picking it up. Some students said 200 grams; others said 300.

“That’s right, it weighs only 200 grams. But how long could you hold it?” the teacher continued. “For one minute? No problem. For an hour? Your arm might start to ache. But what about a whole day? Or a week? You might need an ambulance!” Everyone laughed.

The teacher went on: “This glass of water is actually quite light, but the longer you hold it, the heavier it feels. Stress is the same. No matter how much you’re carrying, if you hold on to it long enough, it can become too much to bear. So we should set down our burdens from time to time, then pick them up again. That way, we can keep going longer.”
english_full:
A teacher was giving a lesson, and the students were listening attentively. “How much do you think this glass of water weighs?” the teacher asked, picking it up. Some students said 200 grams; others said 300.

“That’s right, it weighs only 200 grams. But how long could you hold it?” the teacher continued. “For one minute? No problem. For an hour? Your arm might start to ache. But what about a whole day? Or a week? You might need an ambulance!” Everyone laughed.

The teacher went on: “This glass of water is actually quite light, but the longer you hold it, the heavier it feels. Stress is the same. No matter how much you’re carrying, if you hold on to it long enough, it can become too much to bear. So we should set down our burdens from time to time, then pick them up again. That way, we can keep going longer.”
